name: Summarization Chain
category_description: AI cluster root node (agent, chain, vector store)
description: Use the Summarization Chain node to summarize multiple documents

parameters.name: Use Node Input (JSON)
parameters.description: and Use Node Input (Binary): summarize the data coming into the node from the workflow

parameters.name: Use Document Loader
parameters.description: summarize data provided by a document loader sub-node

parameters.name: Map Reduce
parameters.description: summarizes each chunk on its own, then combines the summaries. This is the recommended option

parameters.name: Refine
parameters.description: summarizes the first chunk, then updates that summary with each next chunk in turn

parameters.name: Stuff
parameters.description: sends all the text to the model in one prompt. Use it for short text that fits in the model's context window

parameters.name: notice
parameters.displayName: Save time with an example of how this node works

parameters.name: operationMode

options.name: Use Node Input (JSON)
options.description: Summarize the JSON data coming into this node from the previous one

options.name: Use Node Input (Binary)
options.description: Summarize the binary data coming into this node from the previous one

options.name: Use Document Loader
options.description: Use a loader sub-node with more configuration options

parameters.description: How to pass data into the summarization chain

options.name: Advanced
options.description: Use a splitter sub-node with more configuration options

parameters.name: chunkSize
parameters.description: Controls the max size (in terms of number of characters) of the final document chunk

parameters.name: chunkOverlap
parameters.description: Specifies how much characters overlap there should be between chunks

options.name: binaryDataKey
options.description: The name of the field in the agent or chain’s input that contains the binary file to be processed

options.name: batching
options.description: Batch processing options for rate limiting
